q.t: What is the degree of 2x² − 5x + 3?
q.e: The degree is the highest power of the variable; here that is x², so 2.

q.t: What is the degree of the constant polynomial −9?
q.e: −9 = −9x⁰, so the highest power of x is 0.

q.t: Which of these is a linear polynomial?
q.e: Linear means degree 1: the highest power of the variable is 1.

q.t: What is the coefficient of x³ in x⁴ − 3x³ + 6x² − 2x + 7?
q.e: The sign in front belongs to the coefficient: the term is −3x³.

q.t: What is the coefficient of z in 4z³ + 5z² − 11?
q.e: There is no z term at all, so its coefficient is 0.

q.t: What is the constant term of 9x³ + 5x² − 8x − 10?
q.e: The constant term is the one with no variable, sign included: −10.

q.t: Find the value of 5x − 3 when x = 2.
q.e: Substitute: 5 × 2 − 3 = 10 − 3 = 7.

q.t: Find the value of 5x − 3 when x = −1.
A chess club charges ₹200 to join plus ₹50 per match. What does a player pay for m matches?
q.e: The ₹200 is paid once; ₹50 is paid m times, so 200 + 50m.

q.t: In 4x + 5y + 3, what is the constant?
q.e: The constant is the term without any variable.

q.t: A player paid ₹750 at a club that charges ₹200 plus ₹50 per match. How many matches did he play?
Two numbers add to 64 and one is 10 more than the other. What is the smaller number?
Find the value of 7s² − 4s + 6 when s = −3.
A tile pattern has 1, 3, 5, 7, … tiles. How many tiles are in stage 15?
q.e: Rule 2n − 1 (goes up 2 each stage, one less than 2n): 2(15) − 1 = 29.

q.t: In the pattern 2n − 1, which stage has 47 tiles?
Bela has ₹100 and spends ₹5 a day. After how many days will she have ₹40 left?
The difference of two positive integers is 63 and their ratio is 2 : 5. What is the larger one?
q.e: Numbers 2k and 5k differ by 3k = 63, so k = 21 and the larger is 105.

q.t: Which describes linear decay?
o: A quantity falls by the same amount every equal interval
A quantity rises by the same amount every interval
q.e: Linear decay = constant decrease per equal interval (negative slope). Halving is not linear — the drops get smaller.

q.t: Salil's mother is 3 times his age. In 5 years their ages will add to 70. How old is Salil now?
Water height in a tank is h(t) = 3 − 0.5t metres after t months. What is it after 5 months (in m)?
q.e: 3 − 2.5 = 0.5 m. It drops 0.5 m every month — linear decay.

q.t: An auto charges ₹25 for the first 2 km, then ₹15 per km. What is the fare for 10 km (in ₹)?
q.e: Only 10 − 2 = 8 km are charged at ₹15: 25 + 120 = 145.

q.t: With the same auto (₹25 for 2 km, then ₹15/km), how many km cost ₹130?
A data plan costs ₹350 for 10 GB and ₹550 for 20 GB, with y = ax + b. Find a (₹ per GB).
q.e: The extra 10 GB cost an extra ₹200, so each GB costs ₹20.

q.t: For the same plan, find the fixed monthly fee b (in ₹).
q.e: b = 350 − 20 × 10 = 150. It's what you'd pay for 0 GB.

q.t: What is the slope of the line y = −3x + 4?
q.e: In y = ax + b the slope is a, the number multiplying x.

q.t: Where does y = 3x − 2 cut the y-axis?
q.e: On the y-axis x = 0, so y = −2: the point (0, b).

q.t: Which line is parallel to y = 2x + 1?
q.e: Parallel lines have the same slope. y = 2x − 5 is always 6 below y = 2x + 1, so they never meet.

q.t: Which point lies on y = 2x + 1?
q.e: Substitute: 2 × 7 + 1 = 15 ✓. A point is on the line exactly when it satisfies the equation.

q.t: Which of these lines is the steepest?
q.e: The slope a tells how much y rises per 1 across; the biggest a gives the steepest line.

q.t: A recharge of ₹600 drops by ₹15 a day. After how many days does it run out?
Multiply a number by 5/2 and add 2/3 to get −7/12. What is the number?
One number is 5 times another. Adding 21 to both makes one twice the other. What is the smaller number?
A two-digit number's digits differ by 3. It plus its reverse is 143. What is the larger of the two numbers?
A linear polynomial p(x) passes through (1, 5) and (3, 11). What is p(x)?
Where does p(x) = 3x + 2 cut the x-axis?
q.e: On the x-axis y = 0: 3x + 2 = 0 → x = −2/3.

q.t: Which pair of lines is parallel: (i) 2y = 4x + 7, (ii) 5y = 6x − 10, (iii) 3y = 6x − 11?
q.e: Divide through: (i) y = 2x + 3.5, (ii) y = 1.2x − 2, (iii) y = 2x − 11/3. Only (i) and (iii) share slope 2.

q.t: Using y = (9/5)(x − 273) + 32, convert 313 K to °F.
Hexagons sharing a side need 6, 11, 16, … matchsticks. How many for stage 15?
q.e: Each new hexagon adds 5 sticks (one side is shared): 5n + 1 = 76.

q.t: p(x) = ax + b and q(x) = cx + d with p(0) = 5, p(x) + q(x) = 6x + 4 and p − q zero at x = 3. What is q(x)?
What do all lines f(x) = ax + a (a > 0) have in common?
o: They all pass through the origin
q.e: ax + a = a(x + 1), which is 0 when x = −1, whatever a is.
